summary: Quiet street kerb by a park, flat near the north end, homes about 20 m off.
reasons: Faces an open park across the road

best_section.where: Baty Street west kerb, between the pool house and the newer houses, opposite the park

drivers.seclusion: Park and trees across the road; hedge and a gap between houses on this side, nearest homes about 20 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both kerbs; a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light local traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7-6 with resident permits excepted; a few cars park along the kerb.

flags: Steep along most of the line: 6.4% mean, 12.2% max, but flat here
New houses at about 182 m (7 to 19 m)
sun_shade: Open to the sky with some shade from street trees on the park side; afternoon sun from the west blocked by houses.
cannot_judge: Whether the new houses at 182 m are occupied
